a: Yazaalibwa mu buddu nga 23 January 1837 mu Long Green, ekyalo eky'abalimi mu Baltimore County, Maryland, ng'omu ku baana kkumi na basatu aba Samuel Berry ne Miriam Matthews. Kitaawe yali musajja munyiikivu, atakoowa, eyakolanga okutuusa mu ttumbi ery'ekiro, oluvannyuma lw'okukola olunaku lwe lwonna, ng'akola bbiraasi n'emikeeka gy'ebisusunku okusobola okufuna omuwendo gw'eddembe ery'ab'omu maka ge, ng'abagula kinnoomu okuva mu buddu. Amanda yakulira ng'amanyi mu mubiri gwe yennyini nti eddembe kintu kya muwendo mungi, era nti liyinza okuwangulwa okwagala okugaana okwebaka.

Okusoma kwe kwakoma ku myezi mitono egyasaasaana; ebyo bye yayiga ku nnukuta ebisinga yabyeyigiriza yekka, ng'awandiika ebigambo mu kitangaala ky'ettaala oluvannyuma lw'okumaliriza emirimu gy'omu nnyumba. Ng'aweza emyaka kkumi n'esatu yatandika okukola emirimu gy'omu nnyumba z'abalala, era mu bulamu bwe obusinga yeeyimirizaawo ng'omwozi wa ngoye, omufumbi n'omuyonjya mu maka g'abazungu okubuna Maryland ne Pennsylvania. Ensi oluvannyuma yandimutuumye "Omutambuze Ayimba" era n'ewandiika erinnya lye mu lipoota z'obuminsani okuva mu masemazinga asatu, naye teyaggwaamu bigambo bya bwangu n'engalo ezaakoowa ez'olubaya lw'okwoza — era ekyo kyawa okubuulira kwe obuyinza obw'enjawulo mu baavu.

q: Nnaku ki ezaali mu bulamu bwe obw'omu buvubuka?
a: Ennaku yajja ng'akyali muto era n'ebeerawo ebbanga ddene. Mu 1854 yafumbirwa Calvin Devine, eyagenda okulwana mu Civil War n'atadda; mu 1863 yafumbirwa James Smith, omudiikoni mu Kkanisa ya African Methodist Episcopal, naye obufumbo bwali buzibu era emirundi mingi obw'obwerere, era yafa mu 1869. Ku baana bataano be yazaala mu bufumbo bwombi, bana baafa nga bakyali bato, era muwala we Mazie yekka ye yakula. Ng'aweza emyaka amakumi asatu mu ebiri yali aziise ba bbaawe babiri n'abaana bana, era yamanya, ng'abatono be bamanyi, akasiriikiriro ak'enjawulo ak'ennyumba efuuse njereere olw'okufa.

Mu Sebuttemba 1868, mu Green Street Methodist Episcopal Church mu New York City, yatuula ng'awuliriza okubuulira kwa John S. Inskip n'awulira Katonda ng'amuwa ekyo abantu ab'obutukuvu kye baayita "omutima omulongoofu" — okwagala kwa Katonda nga kujjuza buli nsonda enzikiza ng'omusana bwe gujjuza ekisenge. Yali ayaayaanira okuleekaana, naye olw'okuba ye yali mukazi omuddugavu yekka mu kkanisa ejjudde, okutya kwamuziyiza emirundi esatu, eddoboozi nga limuwuubaalira nti abasinza abazungu bandimufulumizza ebweru. Ku nkomerero okutya ne kumenyeka; n'ayimuka n'aleekaana nti "Ekitiibwa kibe eri Yesu!" era ekintu ne kiteeka mu ye ekitaddayo kunyeenya.

q: Yategeeza ki bwe yagamba nti "yaguzibwa emirundi ebiri"?
a: Okuva mu kiro ekyo mwe mwava ekigambo kye yaddiŋŋanamu obulamu bwe bwonna: "Ntera okugamba abantu nti nnina obuyinza okuleekaana okusinga abamu; nnaguzibwa emirundi ebiri, ne nsumululwa emirundi ebiri, kyenva mpulira nga nnina obuyinza obulungi okuleekaana." Eddembe erisooka lyagulwa n'entuuyo za kitaawe; eryokubiri lyaweebwa wansi w'omusaalaba. Obuweereza bwe bwonna bwazaalirwa mu kikolwa ekyo ekitono, ekikweke eky'okwewaayo ku ntebe eyo ey'omu Green Street — olutalo olw'ekyama mu kisenge ekijjudde nga tewali mulala ayinza kulaba kye kyamusaba okugondera.

Omwaka ogwaddirira okutukuzibwa kwe yakakasibwa nti Katonda yali amuyita okubuulira — ekintu kya buvumu, kubanga omukazi omuddugavu okubuulira amakkuŋŋaaniro agatabuddwamu era emirundi mingi ag'abazungu, eri bangi, kyali ekitalowoozeka. Teyalina kuwongebwa, teyalina musaala, teyalina kibiina kya ddiini, era teyalina kutendekebwa kwa ttendekero; kye yalina kwali okuyitibwa okw'olwatu n'eddoboozi ery'enjawulo. Ng'ayambadde ekyambalo ekyangu ekya Quaker n'enkoofiira eya poke bonnet, ekitundu olw'okukakasibwa n'ekitundu olw'okuba nga kye kyokka kye yali asobola okugula, yatandika okuyimba n'okubuulira mu makkanisa ga AME ne mu nkuŋŋaana ennene ez'obutukuvu ez'omu nsiisira, ng'eyeeyimirizaawo n'omulimu gw'okwoza engoye wakati w'obuweereza bwe.

Teyeefuula nti okusosolwa tekwamukwasa bulumi, era yakwogera mu bwerufu, naye yagaana okukukkiriza kumutegeeze. Mu kigambo kimu ekyewakanira mu kasirise yakyusa ensonga yonna okugivaako oluuyi olulala: "okugamba nti okuba abaddugavu tekyatuteganya mirundi mingi, kyandibadde si kya mazima; naye nga bwe tuli ab'olulyo olw'obwakabaka, tusuubira okugumira obuzibu buno mu kiseera kino, ne tuyita ne tuyingira mu biseera eby'omu maaso ebinene ennyo, gye ebintu bino ebitono byonna bijja okubula olw'obutono bwabyo obw'amazima!" Ebivume eby'ekkanisa eyawukanyizibwa byafuuka "ebintu ebitono" bwe byageraageranyizibwa n'obusika bwe ng'omwana wa Katonda.

q: Obuweereza bwe obw'emitala w'amayanja bwali butya?
a: Mu 1878 yasaabala okugenda Bungereza, era ekyatandika ng'okukyalira ne kiwanvuwa okutuuka emyaka kkumi n'ebiri egy'okutambula egyamutwala ewala okusinga kumpi omubuulizi w'enjiri Omumerika yenna ow'omu kiseera kye. Yabuulira okubuna Britain, Ireland ne Scotland, oluvannyuma ne yeeyongerayo mu Buyindi okumala emyezi nga kkumi na munaana ng'akubirizibwa Bishop James M. Thoburn, era ku nkomerero n'amala emyaka munaana mu Afirika ey'Obugwanjuba, okusingira ddala mu Liberia ne Sierra Leone, ng'abuulira, ng'alwanirira obwegendereza ku mwenge ng'awakanya obusuubuzi bw'omwenge obwonoona, era ng'atwala abaana Abawafirika abeetaavu okubalabirira. Yagenda ng'"omuminsani eyeeyimirizaawo" — nga talina kibiina kya kumusasulira lugendo lwe wadde okumusuubiza olugendo olw'okudda eka.

Ng'ayolekedde omulimu ogwamutiisa, yatambuza olunyiriri lumu olw'Ekyawandiikibwa ng'essente mu nsawo ye: "Totya, nze nnaakuyamba." Teyalina bbaadi ya buminsani, teyalina musaala oguwezebwa, teyalina tikiti ya kudda ka, okuggyako ekisuubizo ekyo kyokka, era ebyafaayo eby'entambula ze bye byafaayo eby'okukituukiriza — emirundi egisukka gumu essente entuufu ez'olugendo lwe zaatuukanga nga bwe zeetaagisa, okuva mu ngalo ze yali tasabanga. Yali ayize ng'akyali muto nti Katonda addamu okusaba kw'abo ababa baweddemu buli kkubo, era ku kusikanyizibwa wakati w'obukuume n'okugondera yagamba nti: "Okusigala wano ne njeemera Katonda — sisobola kwetikka biva mu ekyo."

q: Kiki kye yazimba mu bukadde bwe, era ajjukirwa atya?
a: Yadda mu Amerika nga mu 1890, era ebyafaayo by'obulamu bwe, "An Autobiography: The Story of the Lord's Dealings with Mrs. Amanda Smith", ne bifuluma mu 1893, ne bifuuka ekitabo ekyatiibwa mu bujulizi bw'eddiini mu Amerika. Nga 28 June 1899, mu Harvey, Illinois, yaggulawo Amanda Smith Orphanage and Industrial Home for Abandoned and Destitute Colored Children, kimu ku bibiina ebyasooka eby'engeri eyo mu ssaza, n'akifukamu amaanyi ge agaasembayo. Yawummula n'agenda e Sebring, Florida, era n'afiirayo nga 24 February 1915 — ng'ajjukirwa ng'omu ku bitangaala ebyaka ennyo eby'ekibiina ky'obutukuvu era eyakulembera okubuulira kw'abakazi abaddugavu.
